//: Travel events: rules that may fire on any journey through matching country.

do.say: On the way you come upon a carter whose wagon has sunk to its axles in the mud. The ox looks at you as if this is somehow your fault.

options.text: Put your shoulder to the wheel.
do: It takes an hour of heaving and swearing, but the wagon lurches free. The carter presses something into your muddy hands.

do.journal: Helped a carter free a stuck wagon.

options.text: Wish them luck and walk on.
do: "Thanks for nothing," the carter calls after you.

choice.cancel: You leave the carter to it.

do.say: The sky turns the colour of slate and a storm breaks over you, rain coming sideways.

options.text: Find shelter and wait it out.
do: You huddle under an overhang until the worst has passed. You arrive late, but dry.
You put your head down and push through the downpour.

then: You arrive soaked and chilled to the bone. (Health: {player.health}/{player.max_health})

choice.cancel: You press on through the rain.

do.say: A hare bursts from the grass almost under your feet and zigzags away.
